title: Chris Coleridge (Associate Professor, Strategy & Entrepreneurship, University of Cambridge) recommends Incorruptible to his materials-scientist entrepreneurs
summary: Chris Coleridge — Associate Professor of Strategy & Entrepreneurship Management Practice at the University of Cambridge, Founding Partner at Technology Innovation Associates, Fellow of Wolfson College Cambridge — publishes a substantive reflection (14 likes) on 21 years of teaching entrepreneurship. As his motivation has shifted from student self-actualization toward societal impact and avoiding unintended negative consequences, he now points students to Incorruptible for the governance framework: 'I have had the misfortune to fall in with some low-integrity folks on my journey… and it's caused me to focus hard on how to empower my students not to overlook the fundamental significance of proper, high-integrity governance as they build.'
blockquote: Those who are especially interested in the latter subject may want to read Incorruptible, by Eric Ries. I have had the misfortune to fall in with some low-integrity folks on my journey… and it's caused me to focus hard on how to empower my students not to overlook the fundamental significance of proper, high-integrity governance as they build.
